arch_workspace_chunk_0.text: langchainx is a Rust port of LangChain.

arch_workspace_chunk_1.text:
It is a Cargo workspace with 13 crates:
langchainx (facade), langchainx-core (shared types, traits, errors),
langchainx-llm (LLM backends), langchainx-chain (chain abstractions),
langchainx-prompt (prompt templates and macros), langchainx-memory (memory impls),
langchainx-embedding (embedding backends), langchainx-vectorstore (vector store backends),
langchainx-agent (agent executor and agent types), langchainx-tools (tool trait and impls),
langchainx-loaders (document loaders), langchainx-text-splitter (text splitting),
langchainx-semantic-router (semantic routing), langchainx-output-parsers (output parsing).

arch_workspace_chunk_2.text:
The facade crate re-exports key types from all sub-crates. Edition 2024, version 0.4.6. Feature flags gate optional integrations: postgres, qdrant, surrealdb, opensearch,
sqlite-vss, sqlite-vec, ollama, fastembed, mistralai, git, lopdf, pdf-extract,
html-to-markdown, tree-sitter, rss, sitemap.

core_traits_chunk_0.text:
The core trait layer defines the primary abstractions:
LLM trait (in langchainx-llm): generate(&[Message]) -> Result<GenerateResult, LLMError>,
invoke(&str) -> Result<String, LLMError>, stream(&[Message]) -> Stream<StreamData>. Chain trait (in langchainx-chain): call(PromptArgs) -> Result<GenerateResult, ChainError>,
invoke(PromptArgs) -> Result<String, ChainError>, execute(PromptArgs) -> HashMap,
stream(PromptArgs) -> Stream<StreamData>. Also has required_keys() and validate_input().

core_traits_chunk_1.text:
Tool trait (in langchainx-core): name(), description(), parameters() -> JSON schema,
call(&str), run(Value), parse_input(&str). Embedder trait (in langchainx-embedding): embed_documents(&[String]) -> Vec<Vec<f64>>,
embed_query(&str) -> Vec<f64>. VectorStore trait (in langchainx-vectorstore): add_documents(&[Document], &Options),
similarity_search(&str, limit, &Options). Retriever trait (in langchainx-core): get_relevant_documents(&str) -> Vec<Document>.

core_traits_chunk_2.text:
BaseMemory trait (in langchainx-core): messages(), add_message(), add_user_message(),
add_ai_message(), clear(). Loader trait (in langchainx-loaders): load() -> Stream<Document>,
load_and_split(TextSplitter) -> Stream<Document>. Agent trait (in langchainx-agent): plan(steps, inputs) -> AgentEvent, get_tools(). FormatPrompter trait (in langchainx-prompt): format_prompt(PromptArgs) -> PromptValue,
get_input_variables(). OutputParser trait (in langchainx-output-parsers): parse(&str) -> String.

core_traits_chunk_3.text: All traits use async-trait. LLM uses Arc<dyn LLM> via IntoArcLLM helper.

llm_backends_chunk_0.text: LLM backends implement the LLM trait. Each backend has client.rs, models.rs, error.rs. OpenAI: uses async-openai crate, supports GPT models, function calling, streaming. Claude: custom HTTP client to Anthropic API, supports Claude models. DeepSeek: OpenAI-compatible API with custom base URL, reuses OpenAI client patterns. Qwen: OpenAI-compatible API with custom base URL, reuses OpenAI client patterns. Ollama: local LLM inference via ollama-rs crate, feature-gated behind ollama flag.

llm_backends_chunk_1.text: All backends convert between their native message formats and the shared Message type. CallOptions struct controls temperature, max_tokens, stop_words, etc.

chain_impls_chunk_0.text:
Chain implementations in langchainx-chain crate:
LLMChain: basic prompt->LLM pipeline. Uses LLMChainBuilder with prompt, llm, output_key,
output_parser fields. Calls FormatPrompter to format prompt, then LLM.generate(). ConversationalChain: LLM chain with memory. Builder takes llm and memory (Arc<dyn BaseMemory>). ConversationalRetrievalQA: memory + retriever for RAG. Builder takes llm, memory, retriever.

chain_impls_chunk_1.text: SequentialChain: chains multiple Chain impls in series, passing output of one as input to next. StuffDocuments: stuffs retrieved documents into prompt context. SqlDatabase: generates SQL from natural language using LLM, executes against database. AgentExecutor (in langchainx-agent): runs Agent.plan() in a loop, dispatching tool calls. Implements Chain trait. Has max_iterations, break_if_error, optional memory.

memory_impls_chunk_0.text:
Memory implementations of BaseMemory trait:
SimpleMemory: stores all messages in a Vec<Message>. No limit. WindowBufferMemory: keeps only the last N messages (sliding window). DummyMemory: always returns empty messages. Used for chains that dont need memory. Memory is passed into chain builders as Arc<Mutex<dyn BaseMemory>> or Box<dyn BaseMemory>.

embed_vectorstore_chunk_0.text:
Embedding backends implement Embedder trait:
OpenAI embedder: uses async-openai for text-embedding models. Ollama embedder: local embeddings via ollama-rs, feature-gated. FastEmbed: local embeddings via fastembed crate, feature-gated. MistralAI embedder: Mistral AI embedding API, feature-gated. VectorStore backends implement VectorStore trait:
Postgres (pgvector): uses sqlx + pgvector crate, feature-gated. Qdrant: uses qdrant-client crate, feature-gated.

embed_vectorstore_chunk_1.text:
OpenSearch: uses opensearch crate with AWS auth, feature-gated. SQLite-VSS: uses sqlx with sqlite-vss extension, feature-gated. SQLite-Vec: uses sqlx with sqlite-vec extension, feature-gated. SurrealDB: uses surrealdb crate, feature-gated. VectorStore Retriever wraps a VectorStore and implements the core Retriever trait,
bridging vectorstore queries into the chain/agent retrieval interface.

agent_types_chunk_0.text:
Two agent types implementing the Agent trait:
ChatAgent: ReAct-style agent that parses text output to determine actions. Uses a chat prompt with system instructions for ReAct format. OpenAIToolsAgent: Uses OpenAI function-calling API for structured tool invocation. Both are constructed via builders (ChatAgentBuilder, OpenAIToolsAgentBuilder). AgentEvent enum: Action(Vec<AgentAction>) or Finish(AgentFinish). AgentAction: tool name, tool_input, log. AgentFinish: output string.

prompt_macros_chunk_0.text:
The prompt system provides macros for composing prompt templates:
template_fstring!(template, var1, var2, ...) - creates FString-format PromptTemplate. template_jinja2!(template, var1, var2, ...) - creates Jinja2-format PromptTemplate. fmt_message!(Message) - wraps a Message in MessageOrTemplate. fmt_template!(HumanMessagePromptTemplate) - wraps a template in MessageOrTemplate. fmt_placeholder!(key) - placeholder for dynamic message insertion.

prompt_macros_chunk_1.text:
message_formatter![...] - composes multiple MessageOrTemplate into a MessageFormatter. prompt_args!{key => value, ...} - creates a PromptArgs HashMap. HumanMessagePromptTemplate, SystemMessagePromptTemplate, AIMessagePromptTemplate
wrap PromptTemplate with specific message types. MessageFormatter implements FormatPrompter and composes prompt chains.
